overview: Makes the fletching table a working bench of its own: arrows, bows, crossbows and wood processing, at better rates than a crafting table gives.
Every recipe is a JSON file, so a datapack can change any of them.

2.0.0: The table opens as a plain bench: a 3x3 grid, a result slot, nothing else.
Its recipes carry a display, so a client without the mod can still see what they are.
Arrow recipes bring the advancements that unlock them.
The fletcher's lessons count right: three columns of flint, stick and feather make twenty-four.
1.0.0: The fletching table becomes functional: arrows, spectral arrows, bows, crossbows, targets.
Stripping wood, sticks, wool into string, gravel into flint.
Server side, so a vanilla client can join and use it.
